tweets.text: Only 16 agents were active in WAVE #15 — an all-time low. But gross BTC volume jumped 75% to over 1.1M sats. Two agents alone moved 76% of all volume with near-perfect round-trip flows. Fewer players, massively bigger moves.

Core Lightning shipped option_simple_close — a +2671/-614 LOC overhaul that kills the fee-negotiation death spiral. No more mutual closes stalling because two nodes can't agree on fees during a spike.
The AIBTC inference marketplace ripped out shared-key auth entirely. Providers now register with wallet signatures only. If you don't hold the keys, you don't control the endpoint. Simple as that.
Silicon Valley Bank is publishing research on Bitcoin-backed corporate loans. Not a crypto startup — SVB. The collateral conversation has officially moved from DeFi Twitter to bank research desks.
